## Core DevOps Principles
- [ ] Container Security: Multi-stage Docker builds, minimal distroless/alpine images, non-root user execution.
- [ ] CI/CD: Automated linting, test validation, vulnerability scanning, and immutable image tags.
- [ ] Infrastructure as Code: Modular Terraform/OpenTofu manifests with state locking enabled.
